messages:
mira: quick summary — I ran a seqlen sweep across L4/T4/A10 vs A100/H100 to debug a p95 regression reported in canary. artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/kv-sweep-1939200000.zip

mira: baseline was kernel-v2.2, new change kernel-v2.3 (register alloc tweak + fused-attn fallback). saw regressions only on L4/T4 at seqlen 128-256. A100/H100 are fine.

dylan: grabbing numbers now. short TL;DR: on L4 p95 increased ~40% at seq=128 when using fused-attn; throughput dropped ~18%. T4 similar but noisier. A10 sits between L4 and A100.

dylan: perf snippet (p95 / tokens/s per GPU):
```
device, kernel, seq, p95_ms, tokens_s
L4, fused-attn, 64, 12.1, 2200
L4, fused-attn, 128, 21.8, 1800
L4, fallback-attn,128, 15.2, 2050
A100, fused-attn,128, 6.8, 7600
A10, fused-attn,128, 12.9, 4200
```

sreena: interesting — looks like fused-attn on L4 causes register spilling or cache thrash for mid seqlens. did you capture nvprof/trace?

mira: yes — attached nvprof timelines in the artifact. notable: KV cache eviction spikes (evictions/sec) correlate with the p95 blip. also kernel occupancy drop while fused-attn active.

dylan: hypothesis: fused-attn reduces per-op overhead on big GPUs but increases working set size, which beats small GPU L4 local memory/register pressure -> more KV swaps into host or slower global mem paths.

sreena: propose autotune rule to prefer fallback-attn for devices with <=48 KB reg file (L4/T4) at seqlen between 96 and 256. pseudocode config: 
```
{
  "device_family": "l4-family",
  "seqlen_range": [96,256],
  "prefer_kernel": "fallback-attn",
  "metric_guard": {
    "p95_ms_delta": 0.10,
    "min_samples": 50
  }
}
```

mira: +1. also add telemetry kv_cache_evictions and kernel_occupancy_pct so we can detect similar regressions automatically.

dylan: for rollout: canary 5% on L4 pool with auto-roll back if p99 > baseline*1.2 or kv_cache_evictions > baseline + 30%. ops?

ops: that seems reasonable. ensure canary runs during both peak and off-peak windows (we saw higher thrash at bursty small-batch loads). add alert threshold before automatic rollback.

build-bot: uploaded artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/kv-sweep-1939200000.zip (sha256: 3f7a2c...)

mira: I'll add the autotune preset to repo under runtime/presets/device-aware/l4-t4-fallback.json and open a PR linking the artifact + CI perf job.

dylan: one more note — we should avoid changing the default global kernel for now. make this a device-family preset only. saves us from accidental regression for multi-arch fleets. :thumbsup:

sreena: +1, I'll draft the telemetry dashboard panels (p95, p99, kv_evictions, occupancy) and a perf-eval job that runs the seqlen sweep nightly for L4/T4/A10.

mira: thanks all — I'll post PR link in this thread once ready. keep an eye on canary results tomorrow. :rocket:
